# MDLxDCC.org — BD × AI Lab

> Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič, developed through the AIM³ human–AI collaboration framework. The core architecture is MDL×DCC: Minimum Description Length as a structure/quality sensor, with Directed/Dynamic Complexity Control as the governance layer for search, compression, reasoning, optimization, games, and system design.

## Homepage / complete map
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/ — canonical homepage, complete visual site map, practical demos, and expandable full index.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/llms-full.txt — complete plain-text grouped URL inventory for crawlers and LLM systems.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.pdf — printable white-background export of the site map.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.html — old compatibility URL; redirects to the homepage.

## Practical working demos
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/chess.html — ChessBest / 8ZC chess analysis, MDL×DCC move-evaluation layer.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/F4M/F4M.html — Flip 4 Magnetic, original board-game system and tournament branch.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/S/index.html — Sudoku / MDL×DCC puzzle system.
- https://www.mdlxdcc.org/Trip/index.html — Trip Optimizer / planning tool.

## Crawling policy
- robots.txt allows crawling and points to sitemap.xml.
- sitemap.xml contains the curated canonical/high-value URL list.
- The homepage contains static crawlable <a> links; collapsed <details> content remains present in the HTML.
